howto: Choose which sums to practise (+, -, × and ÷) and a level, then press Start.
Work out the sum at the top, then move to the lane whose gate shows the answer.
Run through the right gate to score. A wrong gate costs a heart; you have three.
tips: After a miss the right gate lights up and the answer is shown, so you learn the fact.
Grab a shield: it blocks one wrong gate.
Gold gates give a gem. Three gems buy a revive after a crash.
Every 10 right answers earns a medal.
The track speeds up as your score grows, so work the sum out early.

controls.keyboard: Left and Right arrows (or A and D) change lane. Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a lane or swipe left and right

difficulty: Five level bands with an age guide: Easy (ages 5-6), Medium (7-8), Hard (9-10, times tables to 12), Insane (11-12) and Max (13+). Harder bands unlock with XP, and the run speeds up with the score.

features.age-or-level-bands: Level buttons on the title, each with an age guide, plus a choice of +, -, × and ÷
features.hints: After a miss the right gate is revealed; the arcade Hint gives a strategy for the current sum
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: gates and accuracy per level, practice days, the sums missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first run (the gates wait); replay with Learn to play
features.results: Crashed card with score, best, medals and gems, plus a gem revive
